description: a blind review of a branch with four planted defects, one per kind

planted.what: pages start at 1, so page 1 skips the first ten notes, and a page past the end slices out of range
each listed note's file is opened and never closed
read joins the name unchecked, so ../ escapes the notes directory
save reads the whole body before the 1 MiB check, so a huge body is held in memory
